WALLDEF1.DAX:1:3.draft_wall_prompt:
Create brand-new original pixel art. 
Use crisp deliberate pixel clusters, rich hand-shaded materials, and a straight-on orthographic view. This is for a 352 x 352 fantasy first-person view. No text, logos, franchise motifs, or source-game imagery. Create only a plain square backing wall material that fills the canvas. Omit the door, opening, landmark, or other feature. Make left and right edges compatible.
